question: Who among the following has completed his term as the Chair of Governing Body of International Labour Organization in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Apurva Chandra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Apurva Chandra** is** Labour and Employment Secretary.**
 
• He completed his tenure as chair of Governing Body of the **International Labour Organization** on **25 June 2021**
 
• He has handed over the responsibility of the** chair to Ambassador Anna Jardfelt, Permanent Representative of Sweden to the united nations office in Geneva. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
